title: SPT covariance, blinding and CLOE
author: Cail Daley
description: Slides for the Paris CMBX SWG meeting: what the SPT × Euclid analysis needs for its covariance, how the Euclid groups blind DR1 and a proposal for the CMBX blind, and a CLOE likelihood in JAX compared with the dr1_cmbx Cobaya likelihood on a GLASS mock and blinded TR1.

sections.title: Opening
sections.outline: Title and index of the three parts.

sections.title: SPT covariance
sections.outline: What the SPT × Euclid analysis needs from the covariance effort: inputs for SPT-like mocks, constrained realizations on SPT's simulations, and the output wanted.

sections.title: Blinding
sections.outline: What the other Euclid groups are doing, how CMBX chooses its blind, and how to compare with other groups while blinded.

sections.title: CLOE vs dr1_cmbx
sections.outline: From the Cobaya chains of the Q1 analysis to a CLOE likelihood in JAX: what is ported, the same chains with both likelihoods on a GLASS mock and blinded TR1, what a chain costs, and a proposal for a standalone CLOE likelihood beside eDR1like.
